title: Hardware safe-mute response contract is incomplete
component_interface: Watchdog, AMP_MUTE, AMP_FAULT and PGOOD safe state
description: The product requires physical mute during off/boot/fault and fault-injection timing, but does not define electrical defaults, fault propagation or allowed response time. Software alone is disallowed.

evidence.note: Safe-state behavior is required; exact electrical/timing contract remains open.
PDN is active-low; amp can auto-recover after clock fault, so independent safe-state behavior and timing remain open.
R3 reviewed this finding; its existing blocker phase and required external/R4 evidence remain open.
R4 preflight reviewed this finding. R4 electrical closure remains blocked; no R5 schematic approval.

Public official evidence and conditional calculations reviewed; closure criterion is not yet satisfied. Current NXP RM Rev 4 / HW Guide Rev 7 access restriction applies to the RT1062 portions. Finding remains blocking, with original history preserved.

evidence.location: section 10, authorized-manual and owner-input closure audit, 2026-09-30
evidence.note: Owner: <=10 ms is provisional circuit-engineering mute target; production criterion TBD. TAS5825M SLASEH7H p.7 turn-off figure excludes volume ramp and cannot alone prove worst-case fault-to-silence. Exact watchdog/gate/supervisor and response calculation remain open.

evidence.source: Project-owner R4 closure instruction and Analog Devices ADM6316-6322 Rev I
evidence.location: hardware mute item 2; ADM6316-6322 p.3 Table 2
evidence.note: <=10 ms is provisional circuit engineering target only. Fastest screened watchdog W option is 4.3-9.3 ms over specified range; combined mute path is unproven. Production response-time criterion remains TBD.

closure_criterion: Before R4 PASS, approve the hardware default-safe, watchdog/fault/brownout mute dependency and target response-time contract from product/safety input; R2/R3 verify achievable levels and paths. Validate timing physically at EVT/EOL.
